sloka: स हि राज सुतः पुत्र चीर वासा महा वनम् ।दण्डकान् सह वैदेह्या लक्ष्मण अनुचरः गतः ॥२-७२-४२॥
transliteration: sa hi rāja sutaḥ putra cīra vāsā mahā vanam ।daṇḍakān saha vaidehyā lakṣmaṇa anucaraḥ gataḥ ॥2-72-42॥

translations.english: O my son, prince Rama attired in garments of bark along with Sita and followed by Lakshmana left for the great Dandaka forest.
